description: A git graph diffstat link opens the selected changed file in the diff viewer. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a git repository whose commits only ever changed example.txt. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Open the Git Graph tool: click the button with aria-label exactly "Git Graph" in the header's workspace toolbar (".chat-workspace-actions"). 3. ".git-graph-container" should be visible (up to 30s). 4. The first ".git-graph-diffstat-link" in it should be visible (up to 30s). 5. Its title attribute is the changed file's path: it must be exactly "example.txt". 6. Its href must match the regular expression [?&]file=example\.txt (the path, URI-encoded, in a file query parameter). 7. Click that link. 8. The first "select.diff-viewer-select" in ".diff-viewer-overlay" should come to have the value "example.txt" (up to 30s).
